generation: tools/m09-generer-images.mjs (clé lue à l’exécution dans .env.local du dossier principal, jamais affichée ni écrite) ; spécification tools/m09-lot-quai-3.mjs

contenu: aucun texte, lettre, chiffre, signature, filigrane ni logo demandé ; aucune enseigne du jeu de cartes classique ; aucun nom d’artiste ni de franchise dans les prompts

sources.prompt:
Use the attached images only as style references: match the painterly look, fine grain, cold stone masonry, half-timbering, night palette and warm amber lantern light of the harbour scene (first image) and of our harbour facades (second and third images). Do not copy their composition.

Paint ONE isolated layer with THREE different side walls of townhouses, side by side, each filling one third of the image, separated by narrow vertical magenta gaps; each wall seen straight on like an architectural elevation (no perspective, no vanishing lines), rising from the bottom edge of the image to about 90% of its height; these are the long side walls that border narrow passages and the end of a street, about 8 metres long and 10 metres tall. Scale: a person is about 170 pixels tall in this image; doors are about 200 pixels tall. Left wall: rough cold grey stone ground floor, half-timbered upper storeys, two small warm lit windows, a wooden drainpipe, a wall lantern glowing warm amber at head height. Middle wall: plain stone with patched plaster, one shuttered window, iron tie plates, an empty iron sign bracket, stacked crates at its foot. Right wall: the gable end of a tall house closing a street, with a closed arched wooden gate in the middle (the street seems to continue behind it), a small lit window above the gate and a lantern beside it. The roof of each wall is seen edge-on as a thin eave line along its top. The bottom edge of each wall is a straight horizontal line with no ground in front.

Everything around the subjects (above the roofs, between the panels, around the objects) is a perfectly flat, uniform pure magenta (#FF00FF) background with no shading, no texture, no sky, no clouds, no moon, no distant city.

Strictly no people, no text, no letters, no numbers, no signature, no watermark, no logos, no playing-card suit symbols, no emblems on any cloth.

Style bible: stylized HD-2D, theatrical; night with near-monochrome indigo and slate dominant, cold grey stone as secondary, warm amber lantern light, desaturated ivory for canvas and highlights; the four family colours (ember orange, veil blue and silver, bramble green, star gold) only on banners and small accents; props concentrated at focal points, never uniform clutter; world of a harbour city where people challenge each other at card duels.

etapes: fond magenta détouré (alpha tiré de l’écart au magenta, bords démêlés du fond), recadré sur le contenu
trois panneaux séparés par les bandes vides
chacun ramené à la même case (8 × 12.5 m au monde, 64 px/m), côte à côte

murs des passages et des places (colombages, plâtre) gardés sur leurs 9 m du bas (fondu sous la coupe) et assombris de 20 % au pied à 50 % en haut (l’ombre du passage) ; pignon gardé entier, assombri de 8 à 28 %
